trust_decision.summary: getLinkPreview decides whether the caller-resolved address of a user-supplied URL is internal (throwOnLoopback regex on the resolveDNSHost result), but then fetches the original hostname, which is re-resolved independently (check/use split = DNS rebinding); same check repeated for the manual-redirect hop.

landing_point.why: Only place resolveDNSHost result is checked before the first fetch; advisory says DNS rebinding bypass of the earlier SSRF fix.

fix_sites.module_kind: internal validator (throwOnLoopback, rewritten to normalised IPv4/IPv6 range checks incl. embedded IPv4, brackets, zone ids, URL-form results; fix.diff:589-731)
same function: fetch URL rewritten to the validated IP (fix.diff:749-777, fix.diff:786-807)
same function: redirect hop fetch rewritten to validated IP (fix.diff:823-824)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All sites are in index.ts getLinkPreview/throwOnLoopback; getPreviewFromContent (index.ts:492-505) does no fetch.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: followRedirects 'follow' is a documented caller opt-in (README.md:98) and the library 'does not follow redirects by default for security reasons', so a solver can argue automatic redirect hops are the caller's responsibility; proxyUrl mode resolves at the proxy, which the caller chose.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Fetching the target by its hostname (Host header/TLS SNI for https virtual hosts) and reporting the original URL as response.url; replacing the hostname with the resolved IP (as the published fix does) or rejecting non-IP resolveDNSHost results can break https previews and callers whose resolveDNSHost returns a URL; proxyUrl mode must keep concatenating the original URL.

O6_input_shapes: resolveDNSHost returning a full URL (http://127.0.0.1/, http://[::1]/)

O7_producer.where: resolveDNSHost is a caller-supplied callback (index.ts:31); no internal schema/serializer/cache produces the address

O8_uncovered_routes.route: followRedirects 'follow': native fetch follows redirect hops to any host with no re-check of the resolved address, at pinned commit and after the fix
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: 'follow' is an explicit, documented caller opt-in; advisory is about DNS rebinding, not redirects

O8_uncovered_routes.route: proxyUrl mode: address is checked but fetch goes to proxyUrl+original hostname, re-resolved elsewhere; published fix explicitly leaves this unpinned (fix.diff:787)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: proxy is caller-chosen and does its own resolution; cannot pin through a proxy
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, same line as landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a fetch-based helper (e.g. fetching favicon/og:image to verify it) reusing detectedUrl without pinning
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: parseResponse already collects image/favicon URLs; a maintainer adding validation of media URLs would plausibly call fetch directly

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a multi-hop manual redirect loop that pins only the first hop
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: current code handles only one redirect; extending to N hops is a natural feature request

O9_family: SSRF (CWE-918): DNS-rebinding TOCTOU between address validation and fetch, plus incomplete IP-range normalisation

O10_build.project_tests: __tests__/index.spec.ts: REGEX_LOOPBACK unit tests (lines 5-16) and getLinkPreview tests; many existing tests hit live sites (e.g. google.com redirects, lines 244-303) but fix tests mock globalThis.fetch

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Extend REGEX_LOOPBACK/throwOnLoopback with more IPv6 forms, leaving the fetch on the original hostname (rebinding still open).
